rule.name: UAM_qry_practiceQuestionsSet2
rule.definition:
a!localVariables( /*Q1. You have a list of employee records where each record has a name and salary: */ /*{*/ /*a!map(name:*/ /*"John", salary: 50000), a!map(name: "Sarah", salary: 65000), a!map(name: "Mike",*/ /*salary: 55000)} . Write an expression to extract only the names of employees whose salary is*/ /*greater than 52000 */ local!employeerecords: { a!map(name: "John", salary: 50000), a!map(name: "Sarah", salary: 65000), a!map(name: "Mike", salary: 55000) }, /*Q2. A product list contains: */ /*{"Apple", "Banana", "Apple", "Orange", "Banana", "Apple"} .*/ /*Write an expression to remove all duplicates and return a unique list */ local!productlist: { "Apple", "Banana", "Apple", "Orange", "Banana", "Apple" }, local!duplicates: union(local!productlist, local!productlist), /*3. You have two lists: approvedUsers = {"user1", "user2", "user3"} and requestedUsers = {"user2", "user4", "user5"} . Write an expression to find users who requested access but are NOT already approved. */ local!approvedUsers: { "user1", "user2", "user3" }, local!requestedUsers: { "user2", "user4", "user5" }, local!notapproved: difference( local!requestedUsers, local!approvedUsers ), /* 4. A survey collected ratings: {5, 3, 4, 5, 2, 4, 5, 3, 4} . Write an expression to count how many times the rating "5" appears in the list*/ local!ratings: { 5, 3, 4, 5, 2, 4, 5, 3, 4 }, local!count: count(wherecontains(5, local!ratings)), /* Q5. You have a list of order IDs: {1001, 1002, 1003, 1004, 1005} . Write an expression to create a new list where each order ID is prefixed with "ORD-" (result: 1002", ...} ). */ local!order: { 1001, 1002, 1003, 1004, 1005 }, local!expression: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"( items: local!order, expression: concat("ORD-", fv!item) ), /*6. A team has members: {"ORD-1001", "ORD {"Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David", "Eve"} . Write an expression to select only members whose names have exactly 3 letters*/ local!team: { "Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David", "Eve" }, local!members: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"( items: local!team, expression: left(fv!item, 3) ), /* 7. You have sales data for 3 regions: Region1 = Region3 = {1000, 1500} , Region2 = {2000, 2500} , {3000} . Write an expression to combine all sales into one flat list and calculate the total. */ local!region1: { 1000, 1500 }, local!region2: { 2000, 2500 }, local!region3: { 3000 }, local!total: sum( union( local!region1, local!region2, local!region3 ) ), /* 8. A document list contains: {"Report.pdf", "Image.jpg", "Data.xlsx", "Notes.pdf", "Chart.png"} . Write an expression to extract only PDF files (files ending with ".pdf"). */ local!document: { "Report.pdf", "Image.jpg", "Data.xlsx", "Notes.pdf", "Chart.png" }, local!checkpdf: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"( items: local!document, expression: a!endsWith(fv!item, ".pdf") ), local!endwithpdf: index( local!document, wherecontains(true(), local!checkpdf), null() ), /* Q9. You have a list of numbers: {10, 25, 30, 15, 40, 5, 35} . Write an expression to filter and return only numbers between 15 and 35 (inclusive) */ local!numbers: { 10, 25, 30, 15, 40, 5, 35 }, local!filter: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"( items: local!numbers, expression: if( and((fv!item >= 15), (fv!item <= 35)), fv!item, null() ) ), local!nullcheck: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"( items: local!filter, expression: a!isNotNullOrEmpty(fv!item) ), local!returns: index( local!numbers, wherecontains(true(), local!nullcheck), null() ), /* 10. A priority list has items: {"High", "Low", "Medium", "High", "Critical"} . Write an expression to move all "High" priority items to the beginning while keeping other items in their original order. */ local!items: { "High", "Low", "Medium", "High", "Critical" }, local!high: index( local!items, wherecontains("High", local!items), null() ), local!remaining: index( local!items, wherecontains( false(), #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"( items: local!items, expression: fv!item = "High" ) ), null() ), local!begining: a!flatten({ local!high, local!remaining }), /*11. You have employee ages: {25, 32, 45, 29, 51, 38, 41} . Write an expression to separate them into two lists: under 40 and 40 or above */ local!employee: { 25, 32, 45, 29, 51, 38, 41 }, local!employee1:index(local!employee,wherecontains(true(),#"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"(items: local!employee,expression: fv!item>40)),null()), local!employee2:index(local!employee,wherecontains(true(),#"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"(items: local!employee,expression: fv!item<40)),null()), /* 12. A string list contains: {"apple", "BANANA", "Cherry", "GRAPE"} . Write an expression to convert all items to lowercase and sort them alphabetically*/ local!string:{"apple", "BANANA", "Cherry", "GRAPE"}, local!lowercase:#"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"( items: local!string, expression: lower(fv!item) ), /* Q13. You have project IDs: {101, 102, 103, 104, 105} and need to create pairs: 101", "Project 102", ...} . Write an expression to generate this list */ local!Id:{101, 102, 103, 104, 105} , local!project:#"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"( items: local!Id, expression: concat("Project","-",fv!item) ), /* 14. A feedback list contains: {"Project {"Good", "Bad", "Good", "Excellent", "Good", "Bad"} . Write an expression to count occurrences of each unique value and return a summary (e.g., "Good appears 3 times"). */ local!feedback:{"Good", "Bad", "Good", "Excellent", "Good", "Bad"} , local!text:union(local!feedback,local!feedback), local!appears:#"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"( items: local!text, expression: concat(fv!item," ","appears"," ",count(wherecontains(fv!item,local!feedback))," ","times"), ), /* 15. You have a nested list: {{1, 2}, {3, 4, 5}, {6}} . Write an expression to flatten it and f ind the sum of all numbers. */ local!nestedlist:sum(a!flatten({{1, 2}, {3, 4, 5}, {6}})), /* Q16. A list of codes is: {"A1", "B2", "A3", "C1", "A5"} . Write an expression to extract only codes that start with "A" */ local!codes:{"A1", "B2", "A3", "C1", "A5"}, local!extract:a!startsWith(local!codes,"A"), local!startwithA:index(local!codes, wherecontains(true(),local!extract),null()), /*17. You have task durations in hours: {2, 4, 1, 3, 5, 2} . Write an expression to double each duration and return the new list. */ local!duration:{2, 4, 1, 3, 5, 2}, local!newlist:#"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"( items: local!duration, expression: product(fv!item,2) ), /* 18. Two lists represent matched pairs: Names = {"John", "Sarah", "Mike"} and Scores = {85, 92, 78} . Write an expression to find the name of the person with the highest score.*/ local!names:{"John", "Sarah", "Mike"}, local!scores:{85, 92, 78} , local!highestscore:index(local!names,wherecontains(touniformstring(max(local!scores)),touniformstring(local!scores)),null()), /* 19. A list contains: {5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30} . Write an expression to get every other element starting from the first (result: {5, 15, 25} ). */ local!element:{5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30}, local!start:#"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"( items: local!element, expression: if(not(mod(fv!index,2)=0),fv!item,null()) ), local!value:index(local!element,wherecontains(touniformstring(local!start),touniformstring(local!element)),null()), /* Q20. You have department codes: {"HR-001", "IT-002", "HR-003", "FIN-001", "IT-004"} . Write an expression to group and count how many codes belong to each department (HR, IT, FIN). */ local!department: {"HR-001", "IT-002", "HR-003", "FIN-001", "IT-004"},
local!deptNames: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"( items: local!department, expression: left(fv!item, find("-", fv!item) - 1) ), /* Result: {"HR", "IT", "HR", "FIN", "IT"} */
local!unique: union(local!deptNames, local!deptNames), /* Result: {"HR", "IT", "FIN"} */
local!summary: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"( items: local!unique, expression: fv!item & " - " & count(wherecontains(fv!item, local!deptNames)) & " codes" ),
{ local!employeerecords.name, local!duplicates, local!notapproved, local!count, local!expression, local!members, local!total, local!endwithpdf, local!remaining, local!high, local!returns, local!begining, local!employee1, local!employee2, local!lowercase, local!project, local!appears, local!nestedlist, local!extract, local!startwithA, local!newlist, local!highestscore, local!value, local!summary } )
